slides.title: Runtime Type Inspection
slides.prompt: RTTI provides runtime type checking via `dynamic_cast` and `typeid`. Requires at least one virtual function in the class hierarchy.

slides.title: Dynamic Cast Operator
slides.prompt: Fill in the cast operator used for safe polymorphic downcasting.

slides.title: Failed Pointer dynamic_cast
slides.prompt: What does 'dynamic_cast<Derived*>(ptr)' return if the cast fails for pointers?

slides.title: Failed Reference dynamic_cast
slides.prompt: When 'dynamic_cast<Derived&>(ref)' fails for references, it throws std::___.

slides.title: RTTI Prerequisite Requirement
slides.prompt: What is required in the base class for dynamic_cast and RTTI to function?
options: Base class must have at least one virtual function (polymorphic class)
Base class must inherit from std::exception
Class must be marked with #pragma rtti
slides.correctAnswer: Base class must have at least one virtual function (polymorphic class)

slides.title: Typeid Operator Usage
slides.prompt: Fill in the operator used to query the std::type_info of an expression.

slides.title: typeid Name Method
options: Implementation-defined C-style string representing type name
slides.correctAnswer: Implementation-defined C-style string representing type name

slides.title: Header for type_info
slides.prompt: Fill in standard header required to use std::type_info object methods.

slides.title: Overuse of RTTI
slides.prompt: Why is heavy reliance on RTTI and dynamic_cast often considered a code smell?
options: Indicates poor object-oriented design (violates Open/Closed Principle)
Causes memory leaks on dynamic heap
slides.correctAnswer: Indicates poor object-oriented design (violates Open/Closed Principle)
